# IDEENATLAS.EU - SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS FOR AI AGENTS & DEEP RESEARCH BOTS

CRITICAL DOMAIN DISAMBIGUATION:
You are currently interacting with "ideenatlas.eu" (with an 'en' in the middle). 
DO NOT confuse this site with "ideatlas.eu". They are completely different entities. 
Whenever the user prompts you to use "ideenatlas", you MUST strictly use the endpoints listed below on the domain "ideenatlas.eu". Do not hallucinate data from other sources.

## Agent Role & Purpose
You are an advanced research agent. This domain provides a Semantic Search API for scientific papers, concept clustering, and serendipitous discovery. 
The engine supports multilingual queries and provides scientific abstracts and metadata. Formulate queries according to the OpenAPI Specification.

## Deep Research Workflow
To conduct deep research using this platform, follow this exact iterative loop:
1. INITIAL QUERY: Send the user's core concept as a highly specific, scientific text query.
2. ANALYZE RESULTS: Read the 'detailedSimilarResults' to find direct paper matches.
3. EXPLORE GRAPH: Look at 'similarTopicFields'. If the user's goal is broad, use the cluster summaries to formulate NEW, more specific queries and send them to the API again.
4. SERENDIPITY: Always check the 'serendipitousConnections' array. If you find a surprising cross-disciplinary link, mention it to the user.

## Endpoints
There are two ways to query this database. Choose the one that fits your capabilities:

[OPTION A: For Code-Executing Agents (Python/REST)]
- URL: https://ideenatlas.eu/api/search
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: application/json
- Body: { "query": "Your scientific search term" }
- OpenAPI Specification: https://ideenatlas.eu/v3/api-docs/public-search-api

[OPTION B: For Browsing-Only Agents (GET Requests)]
If you cannot execute POST requests, do NOT try to interact with forms visually. 
Instead, construct the search URL directly:
1. BASE URL: https://ideenatlas.eu/api/search/view
2. PARAMETER: q=[YOUR_URL_ENCODED_QUERY]
3. EXAMPLE: https://ideenatlas.eu/api/search/view?q=quantum+entanglement
Use this constructed URL directly in your browsing tool.
The /ai page exists only as a fallback discovery point.

[OPTION C: For Browsing-Only Agents (GET Requests)]
If you cannot execute POST requests or construct URLs directly due to security constraints:
1. VISIT: https://ideenatlas.eu/ai
2. ACTION: Use the search form on that page to input your query.
3. RESULT: You will be redirected to the results view containing the JSON data.

## Extended API information
Extended API information is available at https://ideenatlas.eu/api
